Bill.BriefDescription: Clarifying the development powers of cities, towns, and counties.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to clarifying the development powers of cities,towns, and counties; amending RCW 35.21.703 and 36.01.085; adding a newsection to chapter 35.21 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 36.01RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 35.21.703 and 1985 c 92 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: It ((shall be)) is in the public purpose for, and all cities andtowns are authorized to, engage in economic development programs. Tocarry out the programs, any city or town is authorized to transfer orloan to any other city, town, county, or port district, with or withoutconsideration, any funds, real or personal property, propertyinterests, or services. In addition, cities and towns may contractwith ((nonprofit corporations)) public and private entities infurtherance of this and other acts relating to economic development.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 36.01.085 and 1985 c 92 s 2 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: It ((shall be)) is in the public purpose for, and all counties are p. 1 SB 6236authorized to, engage in economic development programs. To carry outthese programs, any county is authorized to transfer or loan to anyother county, city, town, or port district, with or withoutconsideration, any funds, real or personal property, propertyinterests, or services. In addition, counties may contract with((nonprofit corporations)) public and private entities in furtheranceof this and other acts relating to economic development.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35.21 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any city or town may, upon the request of and pursuant to aninterlocal agreement with a port district, jointly exercise with thatport district any powers of the port district with respect to economicdevelopment programs or projects.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 36.01 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any county may, upon the request of and pursuant to an interlocalagreement with a port district, jointly exercise with that portdistrict any powers of the port district with respect to economicdevelopment programs or projects.

The powers granted by this act supplementthose previously authorized by law. Nothing in this act limits anyother authority of cities, towns, and counties. All prior actionsconsistent with the provisions of this act are validated.
